job.purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_aau-dace0dae3-tc-hm0 (qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4, RTL dace0dae3, snapshot of 6 drifted files): same RTL, outline 388.8x583.2, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:el1011-q-seq

benches.name: band_exact_nl4
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && JOBS=8 bash rtl/test/qwen_lane_band/run_band_lanes.sh {RUN}/bench/band_exact_nl4 -GNL=4 -GNOPS=3000 -GSEED=3 -GRDMEM=1 -GBANR=1
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the dace0dae3 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_m5/src]
